blocks.text: Present Perfect yoki Past Simple — voqea hozirga ulanganmi?

Ikkala zamon ham o'tmishdagi harakat haqida: Present Perfect (I **have done**) va Past Simple (I **did**). Shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 15–20-darslar), Present Perfect ning ma'nolari esa 7–8-darslarda (→ 7-dars). Farq harakat **qachon** bo'lganida emas, uni **qanday ko'rishimizda**: Present Perfect — o'tmishdagi harakat + **hozirgi natija yoki ahamiyat**; Past Simple — o'tmishda **tugagan voqea**, gapda hozirga aloqasi yo'q. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha «-di» bilan tarjima qilinadi («kalitimni yo'qotdim»), shuning uchun zamonni o'zbekcha fe'ldan emas, **vaziyatdan** tanlash kerak.

rows: I**'ve lost** my key. (hozir ham yo'q — eshikni ocholmayman)
I **lost** my key last week. (keyin topdimmi — gap bu haqda emas)
Tom **has gone** to Spain. (hozir o'sha yerda)
Tom **went** to Spain in May. (allaqachon qaytgan bo'lishi mumkin)
The taxi **arrived** at seven. (voqea, vaqti bilan)
Kate **broke** her arm when she was ten.

blocks.text: O'zbek tilida ham bu farqning izi bor: «Qor **yog'ibdi**!» (hozir ko'rib turibman — natija ko'z oldimda) Present Perfect ga juda yaqin: Look, it**'s snowed**! «Kecha qor **yog'di**» esa — o'tmishdagi voqea: It **snowed** yesterday. Shuning uchun o'zbekcha gapda «**-ibdi**», «-ib qo'yibdi», «-ib ketibdi» bo'lsa, ko'pincha Present Perfect mos keladi.

items.text: The fence was grey, but they **painted** it green in May.
items.translation: Panjara kulrang edi, lekin may oyida uni yashilga **bo'yashdi**.

items.text: **Have** you **seen** Aziz? I need to talk to him.

blocks.text: Natija endi yo'q bo'lsa — faqat Past Simple

Present Perfect «hozir ham shunday» degan xabarni olib yuradi. Agar natija allaqachon o'zgargan bo'lsa — kalit topilgan, og'riq o'tgan, lift tuzatilgan — Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi: I **lost** my passport, but the police **found** it («I've lost my passport, but...» emas). Xuddi shunday: The rain **has stopped** (hozir yog'mayapti), lekin The rain **stopped** for an hour, and then it **started** again.

items.text: I **lost** my glasses, but luckily I **found** them in the car.
The internet **went down** this morning, but it's fine now.
items.translation: Bugun ertalab internet **uzilib qoldi**, lekin hozir joyida.

items.text: Bekzod **has lost** his job, and he's looking for a new one.

blocks.text: Yangilik: avval Present Perfect, tafsilot — Past Simple

Yangilikni xabar qilganda (televizorda, gazetada yoki do'stga) birinchi gap ko'pincha Present Perfect da bo'ladi: bu hozir uchun yangi ma'lumot. Tinglovchi «qachon? qayerda? qanday?» deb so'ragach, voqea endi o'tmishdagi aniq hodisaga aylanadi va hikoya Past Simple da davom etadi. Inglizcha yangiliklarning sarlavhasi va birinchi gaplarini shu qolip bilan o'qib ko'ring.

rows: We **beat** Manchester two–one in the final.
Scientists **have found** water on a distant planet.
She **gave** birth on Tuesday morning — a boy.
The thieves **got** in through a window at night.

blocks.text: Hayotdan ketgan odamlar va tugagan davrlar

Present Perfect «hozirgacha» degan davrni nazarda tutadi: bu davrda harakat yana takrorlanishi mumkin. Shuning uchun hayotdan ketgan odam yoki tugagan davr haqida faqat Past Simple: Navoiy **wrote** many poems («has written» emas — davr yopilgan). Tirik yozuvchi haqida esa: She **has written** six novels (yana yozishi mumkin). Xuddi shunday: When I was a student, I **read** a lot (talabalik tugagan), lekin I**'ve read** a lot of books this year (yil hali tugamagan, batafsil → 14-dars).

items.text: Amir Temur **made** Samarkand the capital of his empire.
My grandfather **worked** on the railway for forty years.
My father **has worked** on the railway for thirty years.
items.translation: Otam o'ttiz yildan beri temir yo'lda **ishlaydi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «-di» ni doim Past Simple deb tarjima qilish: «Kalitimni yo'qotdim, eshikni ochib bering» → I**'ve lost** my key (natija hozir); «I've lost my phone, but then I've found it» → I **lost** ... I **found** (natija yo'q); «Navoiy has written beautiful poems» → Navoiy **wrote**; aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan Present Perfect: «I have seen him yesterday» → I **saw** him yesterday (→ 14-dars); yangilikdan keyin tafsilotda ham Present Perfect: «She has had a baby. She has given birth on Monday» → She **gave** birth on Monday.

Amerika ingliz tilida Past Simple ko'proq ishlatiladi: «Did you eat yet?», «I just saw him». Britaniya ingliz tilida (bu kitobda) — Present Perfect: **Have** you **eaten** yet? I**'ve** just **seen** him.

Tekshirish savoli: «**Xo'sh, hozir-chi?**» Gapning asosiy maqsadi hozirgi holat bo'lsa (eshikni ocholmayman, u kasalxonada, bu — yangilik) — Present Perfect. Hikoya qilayotgan bo'lsangiz yoki **qachon, qayerda, qanday** degan tafsilot bo'lsa — Past Simple.

rows: I**'ve cut** my finger — it's bleeding.
I **cut** my finger, but it's fine now.

examples.title: Result now: **I've left** my wallet at home
examples.description: O'tmishdagi harakatning natijasi hozir ko'rinib turibdi — Present Perfect. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-ibdi», «-ib qo'yibdi».

sentences.text: Oh no, **I've left** my wallet at home, so I can't pay for lunch.
sentences.translation: Voy, hamyonimni uyda **qoldiribman**, tushlik uchun to'lay olmayman.

sentences.text: Someone **has parked** in front of our gate again, and I can't get the car out.
sentences.translation: Kimdir yana darvozamiz oldiga **mashina qo'yib ketibdi**, mashinamni chiqara olmayman.

sentences.text: Madina **has cut** her hair short — she looks completely different!
sentences.translation: Madina sochini kalta **qildiribdi** — butunlay boshqacha ko'rinyapti!

sentences.text: The price of petrol **has gone up** again, so we're taking the bus.
sentences.translation: Benzin yana **qimmatlabdi**, shuning uchun avtobusda yuryapmiz.

sentences.text: Look, the snow **has melted**, and the garden is full of flowers.
sentences.translation: Qara, qor **erib ketibdi**, bog' gullarga to'libdi.

sentences.text: **I've hurt** my back, so I can't help you move the sofa.
sentences.translation: Belimni **shikastlab oldim**, divanni ko'chirishga yordam bera olmayman.

sentences.text: **Has** the post **arrived**? I'm waiting for an important letter.
sentences.translation: Pochta **keldimi**? Muhim xat kutyapman.

sentences.text: Our team **hasn't scored** yet, and there are only five minutes left.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz hali gol **urmadi**, faqat besh daqiqa qoldi.

sentences.text: Tom **has broken** his leg, so he's going to miss the rest of the season.
sentences.translation: Tom oyog'ini **sindiribdi**, shuning uchun mavsumning qolgan qismini o'tkazib yuboradi.

sentences.text: Somebody **has eaten** all the biscuits — the box is empty!
sentences.translation: Kimdir hamma pechenyeni **yeb qo'yibdi** — quti bo'm-bo'sh!

examples.title: Finished story: **I lost** my phone — and got it back
examples.description: Natija hozir yo'q bo'lsa yoki voqea o'tmishdagi hikoya bo'lsa — Past Simple: telefon topildi, og'riq o'tdi, lift tuzatildi.

sentences.text: I **lost** my phone on the train, but a kind woman **handed** it in.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni poyezdda **yo'qotdim**, lekin bir mehribon ayol uni topib **topshirdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **broke** his arm as a child, and it still aches in cold weather.
sentences.translation: Aziz bolaligida qo'lini **sindirgan**, sovuq havoda hali ham zirqiraydi.

sentences.text: The lift **broke down** this morning, but it's working again now.
sentences.translation: Lift bugun ertalab **buzilib qoldi**, lekin hozir yana ishlayapti.

sentences.text: We **ran out** of milk yesterday, so Jasur **bought** some on his way home.
sentences.translation: Kecha sutimiz **tugab qoldi**, shuning uchun Jasur uyga ketayotib **sotib oldi**.

sentences.text: Kate **dyed** her hair red for a party, but it's brown again now.
sentences.translation: Keyt bazm uchun sochini qizilga **bo'yatdi**, lekin hozir yana jigarrang.

sentences.text: My headache **went away** after I **had** a short sleep.
sentences.translation: Biroz **uxlab olganimdan** keyin boshim og'rig'i **o'tib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Someone **stole** Oliver's bike last year, so now he always locks it.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili kimdir Oliverning velosipedini **o'g'irlab ketdi**, shuning uchun u endi uni doim qulflaydi.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **find** my glasses? I **looked** everywhere for them!
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni qayerdan **topding**? Hamma joydan **qidirdim**-ku!

sentences.text: The electricity **went off** for an hour, so we **had** dinner by candlelight.
sentences.translation: Elektr bir soatga **o'chib qoldi**, shuning uchun kechki ovqatni sham yorug'ida **yedik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **failed** his driving test the first time, but he **passed** it in May.
sentences.translation: Bekzod haydovchilik imtihonidan birinchi safar **o'ta olmadi**, lekin mayda **topshirdi**.

examples.title: Still true now? **has gone** / **went**, **have left** / **left**
examples.description: Bir xil fe'l — ikki zamon. Present Perfect: holat hozir ham shunday. Past Simple: shunchaki o'tmishdagi fakt, ko'pincha vaqti bilan.

sentences.text: Sarah **has gone** to Edinburgh for a conference, so she's not in the office this week.
sentences.translation: Sara konferensiyaga Edinburgga **ketgan**, shuning uchun bu hafta ofisda yo'q.

sentences.text: Sarah **went** to Edinburgh last month and loved the old town.
sentences.translation: Sara o'tgan oy Edinburgga **borib keldi**, eski shahar unga juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: Jasur **has found** a new job, and he seems much happier.
sentences.translation: Jasur yangi **ish topdi**, ancha xursand ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Jasur **found** a new job in 2020 but **left** after six months.
sentences.translation: Jasur 2020-yilda yangi **ish topdi**, lekin olti oydan keyin **ketdi**.

sentences.text: The guests **have left**, so we can finally relax.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **ketishdi**, nihoyat dam olsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The guests **left** at midnight, and I **washed** the dishes until one.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar yarim tunda **ketishdi**, men esa soat birgacha idish **yuvdim**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **seen** my car keys? I can't find them anywhere.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitimni **ko'rmadingmi**? Hech qayerdan topolmayapman.

sentences.text: **Did** you **see** the fireworks on Independence Day? They were amazing.
sentences.translation: Mustaqillik kunidagi mushakbozlikni **ko'rdingmi**? Ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: Prices **have risen** by ten percent, and families are feeling it.
sentences.translation: Narxlar o'n foizga **oshdi**, oilalar buni sezyapti.

sentences.text: Prices **rose** sharply in the spring but **fell** again in the autumn.
sentences.translation: Narxlar bahorda keskin **oshdi**, lekin kuzda yana **tushdi**.

examples.title: News first, then details: **has won** ... **beat** ...
examples.description: Yangilik Present Perfect bilan e'lon qilinadi (hozir uchun yangi), tafsilotlar — qachon, qayerda, qanday — Past Simple da.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has passed** her driving test! She **did** it on her first attempt.
sentences.translation: Nilufar haydovchilik imtihonini **topshiribdi**! Birinchi urinishdayoq **uddaladi**.

sentences.text: A young boxer from Fergana **has won** the world championship. He **beat** the champion in the final round.
sentences.translation: Farg'onalik yosh bokschi jahon chempionligini **qo'lga kiritdi**. U amaldagi chempionni so'nggi raundda **yengdi**.

sentences.text: Police **have arrested** two men after a robbery in central Manchester. They **were caught** near the station.
sentences.translation: Politsiya Manchester markazidagi o'g'irlikdan so'ng ikki kishini **hibsga oldi**. Ular vokzal yaqinida **qo'lga tushishdi**.

sentences.text: Kate and James **have had** a baby girl! She **was born** on Tuesday night.
sentences.translation: Keyt va Jeymsning **qizi tug'ildi**! U seshanba kechasi **dunyoga keldi**.

sentences.text: **There's been** an accident on the ring road. A lorry **hit** a bus at about eight.
sentences.translation: Halqa yo'lida **avariya bo'libdi**. Soat sakkizlarda yuk mashinasi avtobusga **urilgan**.

sentences.text: Scientists **have discovered** a new type of lizard in the Kyzylkum desert. They **found** it during a spring survey.
sentences.translation: Olimlar Qizilqum cho'lida kaltakesakning yangi turini **kashf etishdi**. Uni bahorgi tadqiqot paytida **topishgan**.

sentences.text: Guess what? Bekzod **has got** a job in London! He **had** the interview online last week.
sentences.translation: Bilasanmi? Bekzod Londondan **ish topibdi**! Suhbatdan o'tgan hafta onlayn **o'tgan**.

sentences.text: The government **has announced** new rules for taxis. They **came** into force on Monday.
sentences.translation: Hukumat taksilar uchun yangi qoidalar **e'lon qildi**. Ular dushanba kuni **kuchga kirdi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **has broken** into the school. The thieves **got** in through the gym window.
sentences.translation: Maktabga **o'g'ri tushibdi**. O'g'rilar sport zali derazasidan **kirishgan**.

sentences.text: Our flight **has been cancelled**! Apparently there **was** a problem with the engine.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz **bekor qilinibdi**! Aytishlaricha, dvigatelda nosozlik **bo'lgan** ekan.

examples.title: **Have you heard** ...? — What **happened**?
examples.description: Suhbat ko'pincha Present Perfect savoli bilan boshlanadi (yangilik yoki tajriba), keyin aniq vaqt va tafsilot haqida Past Simple da davom etadi.

sentences.text: **Have** you **heard** about Tom? — No, what **happened**?
sentences.translation: Tom haqida **eshitdingmi**? — Yo'q, nima **bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **tried** Uzbek plov? — Yes, I **had** it in Bukhara last year.
sentences.translation: Hech o'zbek palovini **tatib ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, o'tgan yili Buxoroda **yeganman**.

sentences.text: **Has** Emma **finished** her report yet? — Yes, she **sent** it an hour ago.
sentences.translation: Emma hisobotini **tugatdimi**? — Ha, bir soat oldin **yubordi**.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **get** those boots? They look really comfortable.
sentences.translation: Bu etiklarni qayerdan **olding**? Juda qulay ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: I**'ve** finally **found** a flat! — Wonderful! How **did** you **find** it?
sentences.translation: Nihoyat kvartira **topdim**! — Ajoyib! Qanday qilib **topding**?

sentences.text: **Has** anyone **seen** the new film about Amir Temur? — Yes, I **watched** it at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Amir Temur haqidagi yangi filmni kimdir **ko'rdimi**? — Ha, dam olish kunlari **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Madina **has bought** a car. — Really? What kind **did** she **get**?
sentences.translation: Madina mashina **sotib olibdi**. — Rostdanmi? Qanaqasini **oldi**?

sentences.text: Jasur, **have** you **spoken** to the landlord? — Yes, I **called** him at nine, but he **didn't answer**.
sentences.translation: Jasur, uy egasi bilan **gaplashdingmi**? — Ha, soat to'qqizda **qo'ng'iroq qildim**, lekin **javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: How **did** the interview **go**? You look really pleased!
sentences.translation: Suhbat qanday **o'tdi**? Juda xursand ko'rinyapsan!

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has** just **come** back from Japan. — Oh, how long **was** she there?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hozirgina Yaponiyadan **qaytdi**. — O, u yerda qancha **bo'ldi**?

examples.title: Closed or open? Navoiy **wrote** / she **has written**
examples.description: Hayotdan ketgan odam yoki tugagan davr haqida — faqat Past Simple. Tirik odamning hozirgacha qilgan ishlari (yana davom etishi mumkin) — Present Perfect.

sentences.text: Alisher Navoiy **wrote** most of his poems in Chagatai.
sentences.translation: Alisher Navoiy she'rlarining aksariyatini chig'atoy tilida **yozgan**.

sentences.text: My favourite author **has written** six novels, and she's working on the seventh.
sentences.translation: Sevimli yozuvchim oltita roman **yozgan**, hozir yettinchisi ustida ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Ulugbek **built** a famous observatory in Samarkand in the fifteenth century.
sentences.translation: Ulug'bek o'n beshinchi asrda Samarqandda mashhur rasadxona **qurdirgan**.

sentences.text: My uncle is a builder and **has built** over twenty houses in our district.
sentences.translation: Tog'am quruvchi, tumanimizda yigirmadan ortiq uy **qurgan**.

sentences.text: Your late grandfather — **did** he ever **travel** abroad?
sentences.translation: Marhum bobongiz hech chet elga **chiqqanmidi**?

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **met** anyone famous? — Yes, a footballer, at Heathrow once.
sentences.translation: Hech mashhur odam bilan **uchrashganmisiz**? — Ha, bir marta Xitrou aeroportida futbolchi bilan.

sentences.text: The Beatles **recorded** most of their songs in London.
sentences.translation: Bitlz qo'shiqlarining aksariyatini Londonda **yozib olishgan**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has visited** more than thirty countries, and she's only twenty-five.
sentences.translation: Sara atigi yigirma besh yoshda, lekin o'ttizdan ortiq davlatga **borgan**.

sentences.text: When I **was** at school, I **read** every book about space in the library.
sentences.translation: Maktabda **o'qiganimda** kutubxonadagi koinot haqidagi barcha kitoblarni **o'qib chiqqanman**.

sentences.text: Our company **has opened** five branches, and the first one **opened** in Tashkent in 2010.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz beshta filial **ochgan**, birinchisi 2010-yilda Toshkentda **ochilgan**.

examples.title: Dialogue: big news at the office
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb yangilikni muhokama qiladi: yangilik — Present Perfect, qachon va qanday bo'lgani — Past Simple.

sentences.text: — Have you heard the news? Oliver **has resigned**!
sentences.translation: — Yangilikni eshitdingmi? Oliver ishdan **ketibdi**!

sentences.text: — What? When **did** he **tell** you? He **didn't say** anything to me.
sentences.translation: — Nima? Senga qachon **aytdi**? Menga hech narsa **demadi**.

sentences.text: — He **sent** an email to the whole team at about nine this morning.
sentences.translation: — Bugun ertalab, soat to'qqizlarda butun jamoaga xat **yubordi**.

sentences.text: — I can't believe it. Why **did** he **decide** to leave?
sentences.translation: — Ishonolmayman. Nega ketishga **qaror qildi**?

sentences.text: — Apparently a company in Oxford **has offered** him a much better salary.
sentences.translation: — Aytishlaricha, Oksforddagi bir kompaniya unga ancha yaxshi maosh **taklif qilibdi**.

sentences.text: — Lucky him! **Has** the boss **found** anyone to replace him yet?
sentences.translation: — Omadi kelibdi! Boshliq uning o'rniga hali birortasini **topdimi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet, but she **interviewed** two people yesterday afternoon.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q, lekin kecha tushdan keyin ikki kishi bilan **suhbat o'tkazdi**.

sentences.text: — And **did** she **like** either of them?
sentences.translation: — Ulardan birortasi unga **yoqdimi**?

sentences.text: — I think so. She**'s** already **asked** one of them to come back on Friday.
sentences.translation: — Shunday shekilli. Ulardan birini juma kuni yana kelishga **chaqirib qo'yibdi**.

sentences.text: — Well, so much **has changed** this month — I need a coffee!
sentences.translation: — Xullas, bu oy juda ko'p narsa **o'zgarib ketdi** — menga qahva kerak!

examples.title: Mixed: results, stories and headlines
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: natija hozir (Present Perfect) yoki tugagan voqea (Past Simple) — yangiliklar, ish, sog'liq va kundalik hayotdan.

sentences.text: The bank **has changed** its app, and now I can't find anything.
sentences.translation: Bank ilovasini **o'zgartiribdi**, endi hech narsani topolmayapman.

sentences.text: When the bank **changed** its app last year, thousands of customers **complained**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili bank ilovasini **o'zgartirganida** minglab mijozlar **norozi bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: **I've cut** my finger — have you got a plaster?
sentences.translation: Barmog'imni **kesib oldim** — leykoplastyring bormi?

sentences.text: Unemployment **has fallen** for the third month in a row, according to the latest figures.
sentences.translation: So'nggi ma'lumotlarga ko'ra, ishsizlik ketma-ket uchinchi oy **kamaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **studied** medicine in Tashkent and then **moved** to Oxford for her PhD.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Toshkentda tibbiyot **o'qidi**, keyin doktorantura uchun Oksfordga **ko'chdi**.

sentences.text: My sister **has** just **got** engaged, and the wedding is next summer.
sentences.translation: Singlim hozirgina **unashtirildi**, to'y kelasi yozda.

sentences.text: Who **painted** this portrait? It looks very old.
sentences.translation: Bu portretni kim **chizgan**? Juda eski ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: The fridge **has stopped** working, and all the ice cream **has melted**.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgich **ishlamay qolibdi**, hamma muzqaymoq **erib ketibdi**.

sentences.text: James **didn't recognise** me at first, because I**'ve grown** a beard since we last **met**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms meni avvaliga **tanimadi**, chunki oxirgi **ko'rishganimizdan** beri soqol **o'stirdim**.

sentences.text: Thousands of people **have signed** the online petition since the story **appeared** in the news.
sentences.translation: Bu voqea yangiliklarda **chiqqanidan** beri minglab odamlar onlayn petitsiyaga **imzo qo'yishdi**.
